quote.text:
This isn’t ready for primetime yet, but I want to share progress on a player-tracking cornerback metric I’ve been working on this offseason I’m really excited about. 

It compares corners to ghost defenders to measure the effectiveness of their pre-throw (targeted or not) positioning.

items.title: I might be in trouble.
items.author: Morten Stig Jensen
items.body_excerpt:
I might be in trouble.

I'm 40 and divorced, which means I'm also 40 and single.

I had, at least, four arrangements with women from my teens, that if we were both single at 40, we'd marry.

... What a marriage slut I was, good lord.

(I have no recollection of who they were, which is even worse.)
